title: GNSS-free gravity-aided navigation in a maritime field trial
source_type: Research preprint, not yet treated as peer-reviewed
source_title: GNSS-free quantum gravity-aided navigation and fine-scale marine surveying with a strapdown quantum gravimeter
claim: The authors report a maritime demonstration of gravity-map matching without GNSS observations in the evaluated navigation solution.
boundary: The result relies on a quantum gravimeter, reference gravity maps, inertial navigation and processing. It does not establish that a gravimeter alone can replace GNSS in general.
